Hello! My name is Luke Snavely, and I am a rising junior and presidential scholar at Robert Morris University, completing my Bachelor's degree in Statistics and Data Science. I am working towards my Master's in Data Science and a minor in Data Analytics. I am set to graduate in the spring of 2027.

I serve as the president of RMU's Sport Analytics Club, presenting on relevant sport analytical topics every month. Through this position, I attend and present at conferences, like the Carnegie Mellon Sports Analytics Conference, compete in hackathons and other competitions, and develop my R coding skills.

I also serve as the president of RMU's Men's Club Soccer team. Growing up near Pittsburgh and playing soccer and baseball, I am a huge sports fan!
